notes: Vana Parva abduction. Draupadi dignified — distress without gore/sexualization. Jayadratha proud then shamed. Comic mythology only. Arjuna Ep 09 face family; no peacock / no gold armor. Local locks under stills/_locks/ must be regenerated at 1536×1024 (current archive is 720p).

draupadi.face: Young woman, warm brown skin, large dark eyes, bindi, resolute dignity — comic mythology, not photoreal
draupadi.hair: Long black wavy hair, exile braid or loose waves
draupadi.costume: Deep red sari with gold border, modest exile jewelry — never sexualized

jayadratha.face: Adult Sindhu king, dark mustache, proud then fearful — comic mythology
jayadratha.costume: Jewel-tone royal silks, Sindhu king — not gore makeup

bhima.face: Powerful warrior, thick dark mustache, fierce resolve — comic mythology
bhima.costume: Saffron-yellow dhoti with gold border, bare powerful chest

arjuna.face: Young archer, thin dark mustache, focused calm — same face family as Ep 09 lock, comic mythology
arjuna.hair: Black warrior topknot — no peacock feather in exile
arjuna.costume: Cream exile dhoti, bow and quiver — not gold battle armor

yudhishthira.face: Gentle eldest Pandava, light dark mustache, composed wise eyes — comic mythology
yudhishthira.hair: Simple topknot — no peacock, no gold battle mukut
yudhishthira.costume: Cream exile dhoti, modest dress, simple sacred thread
